clips.send: A friend who blames a phobia on one bad childhood memory, because this says it's older than that - awe, and a little unease.
clips.caption:
You didn't get this fear from falling in the water as a kid. According to Kevin, it's not even from this lifetime.

People assume every phobia traces back to one bad memory - the near-drowning, the dog bite, the fall. Kevin walks through the obvious explanations for a woman afraid of water, one by one, and rules every single one out.

That's the part nobody tells you: most fears and phobias aren't memories at all. They're something you arrived with.

Comment RISE and I'll send you what it actually traces back to.

#subconscious #energy #pastlife #awakening #innerwork #kevintrudeau

clips.end_words: What did you do to me
clips.send: A friend who's 'tried everything' to quit a food or habit, because this shows the craving itself can be erased, not just resisted - relief bordering on disbelief.
clips.caption:
She was addicted to one specific pint of ice cream - not any flavor, that exact one, every single day. She called it what it was: an addiction, like a drug.

Kevin put the open pint in front of her at a ten-out-of-ten craving and ran one thirty-second sequence. Not willpower. Not a trick to distract her. Just the craving itself, gone.

She picked the ice cream back up to test it - smelled it, imagined the taste - and felt nothing. Zero. She kept asking him what he'd done to her, because there was no craving left to fight.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how a craving actually gets erased.

#subconscious #cravings #mindovermatter #energywork #awakening #kevintrudeau
